step1_analysis.circuit_type: RF Receiver Sub-circuit (Differential Pair and Cascode Amplifier)
step1_analysis.description: The extracted netlist contains a differential pair (XM1, XM5) typically used in mixer or amplifier stages, and a cascode-like amplifier structure (XM2, XM3, XM4) which may be part of the LNA or baseband amplifier. The circuit is a fragment of a 5.2-GHz heterodyne receiver.

paper_reference.title: A 5.2-GHz CMOS Receiver with 62-dB Image Rejection

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the sub-circuit from the 1.8V supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming 3 bias branches (diff pair tail, and two amplifier branches) each drawing ~1mA, total current is 3mA. Power = 3mA * 1.8V = 5.4mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 29mW for the entire receiver. This sub-circuit will consume a fraction of that total power.

voltage_gain.description: Differential AC voltage gain of the XM1/XM5 differential pair.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * Rload. For W/L=5/0.5 and Id=0.5mA, gm is approx 1-2 mS. With a 2kOhm load, gain is ~2-4 V/V (6-12 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 43 dB gain reported in the paper is the cascaded gain of the entire receiver. A single differential stage typically provides 10-15 dB.

bandwidth.description: The -3dB cutoff frequency of the differential amplifier stage.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the RC time constant at the output nodes. With Rload=2kOhm and parasitic capacitance ~50fF, f3dB = 1 / (2*pi*R*C) ~= 1.6 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: While the receiver operates at 5.2 GHz, this specific baseband or IF stage might have a lower bandwidth depending on its exact role (e.g., 23.5 MHz IF).

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power consumption and AC voltage gain of the differential pair. Ideal current sources and load resistors are added to bias the incomplete extracted netlist properly.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Receiver Sub-circuit
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u

* Supply and Inputs
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 dc 0.9 ac 0.5
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 dc 0.9 ac -0.5
VN0 N0 0 dc 0.9

* Biasing and loads to prevent floating nodes
R_N2 VDD N2 2k
R_N8 VDD N8 2k
I_tail N7 0 1m

R_N5 VDD N5 2k
R_N6 VDD N6 2k
I_N3 N3 0 1m
I_N1 N1 0 1m

* DUT
XM1 N2 LABEL_NET_0 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N4 N0 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N5 VDD N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N6 N5 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N8 LABEL_NET_1 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
* DC Operating Point
op
let power = -i(VVDD)*1.8
print power

* AC Analysis
ac dec 20 1M 10G
let vout_diff = v(N2) - v(N8)
let gain = mag(vout_diff)
let gain_db = 20*log10(gain)

meas ac max_gain max gain_db
meas ac f3db when gain_db=(max_gain-3) fall=1

print max_gain f3db
quit
.endc
